# GitHub - outfitter-dev/blz: Local-first, line-accurate search for blazing-fast lookups of llms.txt documentation. Human-friendly, Agent-ready. · GitHub

Source: https://blz.run/outfitter-dev/blz/blob/main/Makefile

```
# Install (one line)
curl -fsSL https://blz.run/install.sh | sh
# Add Bun's docs
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt
# Search (results in 6ms)
blz find "test runner"
# Or just: blz "test runner"
# Browse documentation structure
blz toc bun --tree -H 1-2
# Pull exact lines (citations auto-detected)
blz find bun:304-324 --json
# Or: blz bun:304-324 --json
```

```
# Claude Code
claude mcp add blz blz mcp-server --scope user
# Cursor, Windsurf, and others
# See detailed setup: docs/mcp/SETUP.md
```

```
✓ Added bun (1,926 headings, 43,150 lines) in 890ms
Search results for 'test runner' (6ms):
1. bun:304-324 (score: 92%)
   📍 Bun Documentation > Guides > Test runner
   ### Test runner
   Bun includes a fast built-in test runner...
```

```
# Add source with filtering (default)
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt
# Add without filtering
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt --no-language-filter
# Fix existing source
blz refresh anthropic --reindex --filter
```

```
# Clone and install
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo install --path crates/blz-cli
# Or install directly from GitHub
cargo install --git https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz --branch main blz-cli
# Optional dev build (installs `blz-dev` only)
./install-dev.sh --root "$HOME/.local/share/blz-dev"
# See docs/development/README.md for full local workflow guidance.
```
```
# Add to PATH
set -gx PATH $HOME/.cargo/bin $PATH
# Install completions
blz completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/blz.fish
```
```
# Add to PATH
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
# Install completions (Bash)
blz completions bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/blz
# Install completions (Zsh)
blz completions zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_blz
# Install completions (Elvish)
blz completions elvish > ~/.local/share/elvish/lib/blz.elv
```

```
# Get caught up with blz's features and capabilities
blz --prompt
# List available sources
blz list --status --json
# Add sources non-interactively
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt -y
# Search Bun docs and capture the first alias:lines citation
span=$(blz "test runner" --json | jq -r '.results[0] | "\(.alias):\(.lines)"')
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

```
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

# GitHub - outfitter-dev/blz: Local-first, line-accurate search for blazing-fast lookups of llms.txt documentation. Human-friendly, Agent-ready. · GitHub

Source: https://blz.run/outfitter-dev/blz/blob/main/clippy.toml

```
# Install (one line)
curl -fsSL https://blz.run/install.sh | sh
# Add Bun's docs
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt
# Search (results in 6ms)
blz find "test runner"
# Or just: blz "test runner"
# Browse documentation structure
blz toc bun --tree -H 1-2
# Pull exact lines (citations auto-detected)
blz find bun:304-324 --json
# Or: blz bun:304-324 --json
```

```
# Claude Code
claude mcp add blz blz mcp-server --scope user
# Cursor, Windsurf, and others
# See detailed setup: docs/mcp/SETUP.md
```

```
✓ Added bun (1,926 headings, 43,150 lines) in 890ms
Search results for 'test runner' (6ms):
1. bun:304-324 (score: 92%)
   📍 Bun Documentation > Guides > Test runner
   ### Test runner
   Bun includes a fast built-in test runner...
```

```
# Add source with filtering (default)
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt
# Add without filtering
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt --no-language-filter
# Fix existing source
blz refresh anthropic --reindex --filter
```

```
# Clone and install
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo install --path crates/blz-cli
# Or install directly from GitHub
cargo install --git https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz --branch main blz-cli
# Optional dev build (installs `blz-dev` only)
./install-dev.sh --root "$HOME/.local/share/blz-dev"
# See docs/development/README.md for full local workflow guidance.
```
```
# Add to PATH
set -gx PATH $HOME/.cargo/bin $PATH
# Install completions
blz completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/blz.fish
```
```
# Add to PATH
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
# Install completions (Bash)
blz completions bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/blz
# Install completions (Zsh)
blz completions zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_blz
# Install completions (Elvish)
blz completions elvish > ~/.local/share/elvish/lib/blz.elv
```

```
# Get caught up with blz's features and capabilities
blz --prompt
# List available sources
blz list --status --json
# Add sources non-interactively
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt -y
# Search Bun docs and capture the first alias:lines citation
span=$(blz "test runner" --json | jq -r '.results[0] | "\(.alias):\(.lines)"')
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

```
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

# GitHub - outfitter-dev/blz: Local-first, line-accurate search for blazing-fast lookups of llms.txt documentation. Human-friendly, Agent-ready. · GitHub

Source: https://blz.run/outfitter-dev/blz/blob/main/install-dev.sh

```
# Install (one line)
curl -fsSL https://blz.run/install.sh | sh
# Add Bun's docs
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt
# Search (results in 6ms)
blz find "test runner"
# Or just: blz "test runner"
# Browse documentation structure
blz toc bun --tree -H 1-2
# Pull exact lines (citations auto-detected)
blz find bun:304-324 --json
# Or: blz bun:304-324 --json
```

```
# Claude Code
claude mcp add blz blz mcp-server --scope user
# Cursor, Windsurf, and others
# See detailed setup: docs/mcp/SETUP.md
```

```
✓ Added bun (1,926 headings, 43,150 lines) in 890ms
Search results for 'test runner' (6ms):
1. bun:304-324 (score: 92%)
   📍 Bun Documentation > Guides > Test runner
   ### Test runner
   Bun includes a fast built-in test runner...
```

```
# Add source with filtering (default)
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt
# Add without filtering
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt --no-language-filter
# Fix existing source
blz refresh anthropic --reindex --filter
```

```
# Clone and install
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo install --path crates/blz-cli
# Or install directly from GitHub
cargo install --git https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz --branch main blz-cli
# Optional dev build (installs `blz-dev` only)
./install-dev.sh --root "$HOME/.local/share/blz-dev"
# See docs/development/README.md for full local workflow guidance.
```
```
# Add to PATH
set -gx PATH $HOME/.cargo/bin $PATH
# Install completions
blz completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/blz.fish
```
```
# Add to PATH
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
# Install completions (Bash)
blz completions bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/blz
# Install completions (Zsh)
blz completions zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_blz
# Install completions (Elvish)
blz completions elvish > ~/.local/share/elvish/lib/blz.elv
```

```
# Get caught up with blz's features and capabilities
blz --prompt
# List available sources
blz list --status --json
# Add sources non-interactively
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt -y
# Search Bun docs and capture the first alias:lines citation
span=$(blz "test runner" --json | jq -r '.results[0] | "\(.alias):\(.lines)"')
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

```
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

# GitHub - outfitter-dev/blz: Local-first, line-accurate search for blazing-fast lookups of llms.txt documentation. Human-friendly, Agent-ready. · GitHub

Source: https://blz.run/outfitter-dev/blz/blob/main/manifest.toml

```
# Install (one line)
curl -fsSL https://blz.run/install.sh | sh
# Add Bun's docs
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt
# Search (results in 6ms)
blz find "test runner"
# Or just: blz "test runner"
# Browse documentation structure
blz toc bun --tree -H 1-2
# Pull exact lines (citations auto-detected)
blz find bun:304-324 --json
# Or: blz bun:304-324 --json
```

```
# Claude Code
claude mcp add blz blz mcp-server --scope user
# Cursor, Windsurf, and others
# See detailed setup: docs/mcp/SETUP.md
```

```
✓ Added bun (1,926 headings, 43,150 lines) in 890ms
Search results for 'test runner' (6ms):
1. bun:304-324 (score: 92%)
   📍 Bun Documentation > Guides > Test runner
   ### Test runner
   Bun includes a fast built-in test runner...
```

```
# Add source with filtering (default)
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt
# Add without filtering
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt --no-language-filter
# Fix existing source
blz refresh anthropic --reindex --filter
```

```
# Clone and install
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo install --path crates/blz-cli
# Or install directly from GitHub
cargo install --git https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz --branch main blz-cli
# Optional dev build (installs `blz-dev` only)
./install-dev.sh --root "$HOME/.local/share/blz-dev"
# See docs/development/README.md for full local workflow guidance.
```
```
# Add to PATH
set -gx PATH $HOME/.cargo/bin $PATH
# Install completions
blz completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/blz.fish
```
```
# Add to PATH
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
# Install completions (Bash)
blz completions bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/blz
# Install completions (Zsh)
blz completions zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_blz
# Install completions (Elvish)
blz completions elvish > ~/.local/share/elvish/lib/blz.elv
```

```
# Get caught up with blz's features and capabilities
blz --prompt
# List available sources
blz list --status --json
# Add sources non-interactively
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt -y
# Search Bun docs and capture the first alias:lines citation
span=$(blz "test runner" --json | jq -r '.results[0] | "\(.alias):\(.lines)"')
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

```
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

# GitHub - outfitter-dev/blz: Local-first, line-accurate search for blazing-fast lookups of llms.txt documentation. Human-friendly, Agent-ready. · GitHub

Source: https://blz.run/outfitter-dev/blz/blob/main/rustfmt.toml

```
# Install (one line)
curl -fsSL https://blz.run/install.sh | sh
# Add Bun's docs
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt
# Search (results in 6ms)
blz find "test runner"
# Or just: blz "test runner"
# Browse documentation structure
blz toc bun --tree -H 1-2
# Pull exact lines (citations auto-detected)
blz find bun:304-324 --json
# Or: blz bun:304-324 --json
```

```
# Claude Code
claude mcp add blz blz mcp-server --scope user
# Cursor, Windsurf, and others
# See detailed setup: docs/mcp/SETUP.md
```

```
✓ Added bun (1,926 headings, 43,150 lines) in 890ms
Search results for 'test runner' (6ms):
1. bun:304-324 (score: 92%)
   📍 Bun Documentation > Guides > Test runner
   ### Test runner
   Bun includes a fast built-in test runner...
```

```
# Add source with filtering (default)
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt
# Add without filtering
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt --no-language-filter
# Fix existing source
blz refresh anthropic --reindex --filter
```

```
# Clone and install
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo install --path crates/blz-cli
# Or install directly from GitHub
cargo install --git https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz --branch main blz-cli
# Optional dev build (installs `blz-dev` only)
./install-dev.sh --root "$HOME/.local/share/blz-dev"
# See docs/development/README.md for full local workflow guidance.
```
```
# Add to PATH
set -gx PATH $HOME/.cargo/bin $PATH
# Install completions
blz completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/blz.fish
```
```
# Add to PATH
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
# Install completions (Bash)
blz completions bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/blz
# Install completions (Zsh)
blz completions zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_blz
# Install completions (Elvish)
blz completions elvish > ~/.local/share/elvish/lib/blz.elv
```

```
# Get caught up with blz's features and capabilities
blz --prompt
# List available sources
blz list --status --json
# Add sources non-interactively
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt -y
# Search Bun docs and capture the first alias:lines citation
span=$(blz "test runner" --json | jq -r '.results[0] | "\(.alias):\(.lines)"')
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
```

```
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

# GitHub - outfitter-dev/blz: Local-first, line-accurate search for blazing-fast lookups of llms.txt documentation. Human-friendly, Agent-ready. · GitHub

Source: https://blz.run/outfitter-dev/blz/blob/main/docs/architecture/README.md

```
# Install (one line)
curl -fsSL https://blz.run/install.sh | sh
# Add Bun's docs
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt
# Search (results in 6ms)
blz find "test runner"
# Or just: blz "test runner"
# Browse documentation structure
blz toc bun --tree -H 1-2
# Pull exact lines (citations auto-detected)
blz find bun:304-324 --json
# Or: blz bun:304-324 --json
```

```
# Claude Code
claude mcp add blz blz mcp-server --scope user
# Cursor, Windsurf, and others
# See detailed setup: docs/mcp/SETUP.md
```

```
✓ Added bun (1,926 headings, 43,150 lines) in 890ms
Search results for 'test runner' (6ms):
1. bun:304-324 (score: 92%)
   📍 Bun Documentation > Guides > Test runner
   ### Test runner
   Bun includes a fast built-in test runner...
```

```
# Add source with filtering (default)
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt
# Add without filtering
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt --no-language-filter
# Fix existing source
blz refresh anthropic --reindex --filter
```

```
# Clone and install
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo install --path crates/blz-cli
# Or install directly from GitHub
cargo install --git https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz --branch main blz-cli
# Optional dev build (installs `blz-dev` only)
./install-dev.sh --root "$HOME/.local/share/blz-dev"
# See docs/development/README.md for full local workflow guidance.
```
```
# Add to PATH
set -gx PATH $HOME/.cargo/bin $PATH
# Install completions
blz completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/blz.fish
```
```
# Add to PATH
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
# Install completions (Bash)
blz completions bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/blz
# Install completions (Zsh)
blz completions zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_blz
# Install completions (Elvish)
blz completions elvish > ~/.local/share/elvish/lib/blz.elv
```

```
# Get caught up with blz's features and capabilities
blz --prompt
# List available sources
blz list --status --json
# Add sources non-interactively
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt -y
# Search Bun docs and capture the first alias:lines citation
span=$(blz "test runner" --json | jq -r '.results[0] | "\(.alias):\(.lines)"')
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
```

```
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

# GitHub - outfitter-dev/blz: Local-first, line-accurate search for blazing-fast lookups of llms.txt documentation. Human-friendly, Agent-ready. · GitHub

Source: https://blz.run/outfitter-dev/blz/blob/main/docs/cli/howto.md

```
# Install (one line)
curl -fsSL https://blz.run/install.sh | sh
# Add Bun's docs
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt
# Search (results in 6ms)
blz find "test runner"
# Or just: blz "test runner"
# Browse documentation structure
blz toc bun --tree -H 1-2
# Pull exact lines (citations auto-detected)
blz find bun:304-324 --json
# Or: blz bun:304-324 --json
```

```
# Claude Code
claude mcp add blz blz mcp-server --scope user
# Cursor, Windsurf, and others
# See detailed setup: docs/mcp/SETUP.md
```

```
✓ Added bun (1,926 headings, 43,150 lines) in 890ms
Search results for 'test runner' (6ms):
1. bun:304-324 (score: 92%)
   📍 Bun Documentation > Guides > Test runner
   ### Test runner
   Bun includes a fast built-in test runner...
```

```
# Add source with filtering (default)
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt
# Add without filtering
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt --no-language-filter
# Fix existing source
blz refresh anthropic --reindex --filter
```

```
# Clone and install
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo install --path crates/blz-cli
# Or install directly from GitHub
cargo install --git https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz --branch main blz-cli
# Optional dev build (installs `blz-dev` only)
./install-dev.sh --root "$HOME/.local/share/blz-dev"
# See docs/development/README.md for full local workflow guidance.
```
```
# Add to PATH
set -gx PATH $HOME/.cargo/bin $PATH
# Install completions
blz completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/blz.fish
```
```
# Add to PATH
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
# Install completions (Bash)
blz completions bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/blz
# Install completions (Zsh)
blz completions zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_blz
# Install completions (Elvish)
blz completions elvish > ~/.local/share/elvish/lib/blz.elv
```

```
# Get caught up with blz's features and capabilities
blz --prompt
# List available sources
blz list --status --json
# Add sources non-interactively
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt -y
# Search Bun docs and capture the first alias:lines citation
span=$(blz "test runner" --json | jq -r '.results[0] | "\(.alias):\(.lines)"')
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```

blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

# GitHub - outfitter-dev/blz: Local-first, line-accurate search for blazing-fast lookups of llms.txt documentation. Human-friendly, Agent-ready. · GitHub

Source: https://blz.run/outfitter-dev/blz/blob/main/docs/cli/shell_integration.md

```
# Install (one line)
curl -fsSL https://blz.run/install.sh | sh
# Add Bun's docs
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt
# Search (results in 6ms)
blz find "test runner"
# Or just: blz "test runner"
# Browse documentation structure
blz toc bun --tree -H 1-2
# Pull exact lines (citations auto-detected)
blz find bun:304-324 --json
# Or: blz bun:304-324 --json
```

```
# Claude Code
claude mcp add blz blz mcp-server --scope user
# Cursor, Windsurf, and others
# See detailed setup: docs/mcp/SETUP.md
```

```
✓ Added bun (1,926 headings, 43,150 lines) in 890ms
Search results for 'test runner' (6ms):
1. bun:304-324 (score: 92%)
   📍 Bun Documentation > Guides > Test runner
   ### Test runner
   Bun includes a fast built-in test runner...
```

```
# Add source with filtering (default)
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt
# Add without filtering
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt --no-language-filter
# Fix existing source
blz refresh anthropic --reindex --filter
```

```
# Clone and install
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo install --path crates/blz-cli
# Or install directly from GitHub
cargo install --git https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz --branch main blz-cli
# Optional dev build (installs `blz-dev` only)
./install-dev.sh --root "$HOME/.local/share/blz-dev"
# See docs/development/README.md for full local workflow guidance.
```
```
# Add to PATH
set -gx PATH $HOME/.cargo/bin $PATH
# Install completions
blz completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/blz.fish
```
```
# Add to PATH
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
# Install completions (Bash)
blz completions bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/blz
# Install completions (Zsh)
blz completions zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_blz
# Install completions (Elvish)
blz completions elvish > ~/.local/share/elvish/lib/blz.elv
```

```
# Get caught up with blz's features and capabilities
blz --prompt
# List available sources
blz list --status --json
# Add sources non-interactively
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt -y
# Search Bun docs and capture the first alias:lines citation
span=$(blz "test runner" --json | jq -r '.results[0] | "\(.alias):\(.lines)"')
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation

  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```

blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish

#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
```

```
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt -y
# Search Bun docs and capture the first alias:lines citation
span=$(blz "test runner" --json | jq -r '.results[0] | "\(.alias):\(.lines)"')
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

# GitHub - outfitter-dev/blz: Local-first, line-accurate search for blazing-fast lookups of llms.txt documentation. Human-friendly, Agent-ready. · GitHub

Source: https://blz.run/topics/agents

```
# Install (one line)
curl -fsSL https://blz.run/install.sh | sh
# Add Bun's docs
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt
# Search (results in 6ms)
blz find "test runner"
# Or just: blz "test runner"
# Browse documentation structure
blz toc bun --tree -H 1-2
# Pull exact lines (citations auto-detected)
blz find bun:304-324 --json
# Or: blz bun:304-324 --json
```

```
# Claude Code
claude mcp add blz blz mcp-server --scope user
# Cursor, Windsurf, and others
# See detailed setup: docs/mcp/SETUP.md
```

```
✓ Added bun (1,926 headings, 43,150 lines) in 890ms
Search results for 'test runner' (6ms):
1. bun:304-324 (score: 92%)
   📍 Bun Documentation > Guides > Test runner
   ### Test runner
   Bun includes a fast built-in test runner...
```

```
# Add source with filtering (default)
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt
# Add without filtering
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt --no-language-filter
# Fix existing source
blz refresh anthropic --reindex --filter
```

```
# Clone and install
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo install --path crates/blz-cli
# Or install directly from GitHub
cargo install --git https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz --branch main blz-cli
# Optional dev build (installs `blz-dev` only)
./install-dev.sh --root "$HOME/.local/share/blz-dev"
# See docs/development/README.md for full local workflow guidance.
```
```
# Add to PATH
set -gx PATH $HOME/.cargo/bin $PATH
# Install completions
blz completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/blz.fish
```
```
# Add to PATH
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
# Install completions (Bash)
blz completions bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/blz
# Install completions (Zsh)
blz completions zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_blz
# Install completions (Elvish)
blz completions elvish > ~/.local/share/elvish/lib/blz.elv
```

```
# Get caught up with blz's features and capabilities
blz --prompt
# List available sources
blz list --status --json
# Add sources non-interactively
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt -y
# Search Bun docs and capture the first alias:lines citation
span=$(blz "test runner" --json | jq -r '.results[0] | "\(.alias):\(.lines)"')
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation

  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```

blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Search Bun docs and capture the first alias:lines citation
span=$(blz "test runner" --json | jq -r '.results[0] | "\(.alias):\(.lines)"')
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

# GitHub - outfitter-dev/blz: Local-first, line-accurate search for blazing-fast lookups of llms.txt documentation. Human-friendly, Agent-ready. · GitHub

Source: https://blz.run/outfitter-dev/blz/activity

```
# Install (one line)
curl -fsSL https://blz.run/install.sh | sh
# Add Bun's docs
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt
# Search (results in 6ms)
blz find "test runner"
# Or just: blz "test runner"
# Browse documentation structure
blz toc bun --tree -H 1-2
# Pull exact lines (citations auto-detected)
blz find bun:304-324 --json
# Or: blz bun:304-324 --json
```

```
# Claude Code
claude mcp add blz blz mcp-server --scope user
# Cursor, Windsurf, and others
# See detailed setup: docs/mcp/SETUP.md
```

```
✓ Added bun (1,926 headings, 43,150 lines) in 890ms
Search results for 'test runner' (6ms):
1. bun:304-324 (score: 92%)
   📍 Bun Documentation > Guides > Test runner
   ### Test runner
   Bun includes a fast built-in test runner...
```

```
# Add source with filtering (default)
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt
# Add without filtering
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt --no-language-filter
# Fix existing source
blz refresh anthropic --reindex --filter
```

```
# Clone and install
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo install --path crates/blz-cli
# Or install directly from GitHub
cargo install --git https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz --branch main blz-cli
# Optional dev build (installs `blz-dev` only)
./install-dev.sh --root "$HOME/.local/share/blz-dev"
# See docs/development/README.md for full local workflow guidance.
```
```
# Add to PATH
set -gx PATH $HOME/.cargo/bin $PATH
# Install completions
blz completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/blz.fish
```
```
# Add to PATH
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
# Install completions (Bash)
blz completions bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/blz
# Install completions (Zsh)
blz completions zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_blz
# Install completions (Elvish)
blz completions elvish > ~/.local/share/elvish/lib/blz.elv
```

```
# Get caught up with blz's features and capabilities
blz --prompt
# List available sources
blz list --status --json
# Add sources non-interactively
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt -y

# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```

# Get exact line ranges

# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)

```

```
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt -y
# Search Bun docs and capture the first alias:lines citation
span=$(blz "test runner" --json | jq -r '.results[0] | "\(.alias):\(.lines)"')
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

```
   ### Test runner
```

```
blz completions elvish > ~/.local/share/elvish/lib/blz.elv
```

```
# Get caught up with blz's features and capabilities
blz --prompt
# List available sources
blz list --status --json
# Add sources non-interactively
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt -y
# Search Bun docs and capture the first alias:lines citation
span=$(blz "test runner" --json | jq -r '.results[0] | "\(.alias):\(.lines)"')
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

# GitHub - outfitter-dev/blz: Local-first, line-accurate search for blazing-fast lookups of llms.txt documentation. Human-friendly, Agent-ready. · GitHub

```
   ### Test runner
   Bun includes a fast built-in test runner...
```

```
# Add without filtering

# Fix existing source
blz refresh anthropic --reindex --filter
```

```
blz completions zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_blz
# Install completions (Elvish)
blz completions elvish > ~/.local/share/elvish/lib/blz.elv
```

```
# Get caught up with blz's features and capabilities
blz --prompt
# List available sources
blz list --status --json
# Add sources non-interactively
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt -y
# Search Bun docs and capture the first alias:lines citation
span=$(blz "test runner" --json | jq -r '.results[0] | "\(.alias):\(.lines)"')
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

# GitHub - outfitter-dev/blz: Local-first, line-accurate search for blazing-fast lookups of llms.txt documentation. Human-friendly, Agent-ready. · GitHub

Source: https://blz.run/outfitter-dev/blz/search?l=javascript

```
# Install (one line)
curl -fsSL https://blz.run/install.sh | sh
# Add Bun's docs
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt
# Search (results in 6ms)
blz find "test runner"
# Or just: blz "test runner"
# Browse documentation structure
blz toc bun --tree -H 1-2
# Pull exact lines (citations auto-detected)
blz find bun:304-324 --json
# Or: blz bun:304-324 --json
```

```
# Claude Code
claude mcp add blz blz mcp-server --scope user
# Cursor, Windsurf, and others
# See detailed setup: docs/mcp/SETUP.md
```

```
✓ Added bun (1,926 headings, 43,150 lines) in 890ms
Search results for 'test runner' (6ms):
1. bun:304-324 (score: 92%)
   📍 Bun Documentation > Guides > Test runner
   ### Test runner
   Bun includes a fast built-in test runner...
```

```
# Add source with filtering (default)
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt
# Add without filtering
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt --no-language-filter
# Fix existing source
blz refresh anthropic --reindex --filter
```

```

# Or install directly from GitHub
```

```
# Fix existing source
blz refresh anthropic --reindex --filter
```

```
# Clone and install
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo install --path crates/blz-cli
# Or install directly from GitHub
cargo install --git https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz --branch main blz-cli
# Optional dev build (installs `blz-dev` only)
./install-dev.sh --root "$HOME/.local/share/blz-dev"
# See docs/development/README.md for full local workflow guidance.
```
```
# Add to PATH
set -gx PATH $HOME/.cargo/bin $PATH
# Install completions
blz completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/blz.fish
```
```
# Add to PATH
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
# Install completions (Bash)
blz completions bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/blz
# Install completions (Zsh)
blz completions zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_blz
# Install completions (Elvish)
blz completions elvish > ~/.local/share/elvish/lib/blz.elv
```

```
# Get caught up with blz's features and capabilities
blz --prompt
# List available sources
blz list --status --json
# Add sources non-interactively
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt -y
# Search Bun docs and capture the first alias:lines citation
span=$(blz "test runner" --json | jq -r '.results[0] | "\(.alias):\(.lines)"')
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
{
  "alias": "bun",
  "file": "llms.txt",
  "headingPath": ["CLI", "Flags"],
  "lines": "311-339",
  "snippet": "--concurrency<N> ...",
  "score": 12.47,
  "sourceUrl": "https://bun.sh/llms.txt#L311-L339",
  "checksum": "sha256:..."
}
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```

# GitHub - outfitter-dev/blz: Local-first, line-accurate search for blazing-fast lookups of llms.txt documentation. Human-friendly, Agent-ready. · GitHub

```

# Or just: blz "test runner"
# Browse documentation structure

# Pull exact lines (citations auto-detected)
blz find bun:304-324 --json
# Or: blz bun:304-324 --json
```

```
   ### Test runner
   Bun includes a fast built-in test runner...

```
```
# Add source with filtering (default)
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt
# Add without filtering
blz add anthropic https://docs.anthropic.com/llms-full.txt --no-language-filter
# Fix existing source
blz refresh anthropic --reindex --filter
```

```
# Clone and install
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo install --path crates/blz-cli
# Or install directly from GitHub
cargo install --git https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz --branch main blz-cli
# Optional dev build (installs `blz-dev` only)
./install-dev.sh --root "$HOME/.local/share/blz-dev"
# See docs/development/README.md for full local workflow guidance.
```
```
# Add to PATH
set -gx PATH $HOME/.cargo/bin $PATH
# Install completions
blz completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/blz.fish
```
```
# Add to PATH
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
# Install completions (Bash)
blz completions bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/blz
# Install completions (Zsh)
blz completions zsh > ~/.zsh/completions/_blz
# Install completions (Elvish)
blz completions elvish > ~/.local/share/elvish/lib/blz.elv
```

```
# Get caught up with blz's features and capabilities
blz --prompt
# List available sources
blz list --status --json
# Add sources non-interactively
blz add bun https://bun.sh/llms.txt -y
# Search Bun docs and capture the first alias:lines citation
span=$(blz "test runner" --json | jq -r '.results[0] | "\(.alias):\(.lines)"')
# Retrieve the exact line with 5 lines of context on either side
blz get "$span" -C 5 --json
# Need more than one range? Comma-separate them after the alias
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Want the full heading section? Expand with --context all (and cap the output)
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
```

```
# Search for documentation
blz "test runner" -s bun --json
# Get exact line ranges
blz get bun:423-445
# Merge multiple spans for the same source (comma-separated)
blz get bun:41994-42009,42010-42020 --json
# Expand to the entire heading block when the agent needs full prose
blz get bun:41994-42009 --context all --max-lines 80 --json
# List all indexed sources (note: list returns array; search returns object with .results)
blz list --json | jq 'length'
```

```
// Search for documentation
find({
  query: "test runner",
  source: "bun",
  maxResults: 5
})
// Retrieve exact content
find({
  snippets: ["bun:304-324"],
  contextMode: "symmetric"
})
```

```
# Generate completions for your shell
blz completions fish    # Fish shell
blz completions bash    # Bash
blz completions zsh     # Zsh
blz completions elvish  # Elvish
# Dynamic completions (optional)
#  - Zsh:  source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.zsh (after compinit)
#  - Fish: source ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.fish
#  - PS:   . ./scripts/blz-dynamic-completions.ps1
# Example: dynamic alias completion
blz <TAB>                 # Shows your indexed aliases
blz get <TAB>             # Completes with your indexed aliases
```

```
# Run the install script after updates
./scripts/install-completions.sh
```

```
git clone https://github.com/outfitter-dev/blz
cd blz
cargo build --release
cargo nextest run --workspace  # or: cargo test --workspace
cargo install --path .
```
